Our Mission Empowering Growth, Embracing Hispanic Heritage. Unidos en Progreso. The Midland Hispanic Chamber of Commerce is the vital hub for connecting, developing, and promoting Hispanic-owned and community-focused businesses in Midland, Texas. Join Our Community Unlock Your Potential. Elevate Your Business. Joining the MHCC gives you immediate access to a powerful network and invaluable resources designed to help your Midland business thrive. Become a Member Strategic Networking Connect with influential leaders and potential clients at our exclusive events, from our monthly Café con Pan networking to our annual Awards Gala. Business Advocacy Gain a powerful voice as we advocate for policies that support small business growth and economic development right here in Midland. Enhanced Visibility Increase your exposure through our online directory, event sponsorships, member spotlights, and celebrated ribbon-cutting ceremonies.
Professional Development Access exclusive workshops and training seminars designed to sharpen your skills and grow your enterprise in today's market.

About | MHCC top of page Log In Log In About Us The Midland Hispanic Chamber of Commerce (MHCC) was founded in October 1984 by a group of local businesspeople and professionals who recognized the need for an organization that would support Hispanic businesses in the Midland community. The Chamber's mission focuses on growth, support, and community engagement. It aims to provide commerce opportunities through quality education, business, jobs, and life. The vision includes uniting small businesses and professionals under the leadership of an elected Board of Directors to achieve common goals. Formation and Early Years (1984): The MHCC was established to cater specifically to the needs of Hispanic businesses and professionals in Midland. The founding members aimed to unite these businesses under one umbrella to foster prosperity and pride within the community. Mex-Tex Family Fiesta (1987): Initially known as the Mex-Tex Menudo Cook-Off, this event has become the largest celebration of Hispanic culture in the Permian Basin, attracting over 10,000 attendees annually. Our vision of uniting Midland's small businesses and professionals under one umbrella - following the leadership and guidance of an elected policy-making Board of Directors, and working towards a common goal, will bring prosperity and pride not only to our members, but also to the community.

Key Historical Milestones Carol Garza brings nearly 30 years of real estate expertise to the Permian Basin, specializing in residential sales and property management. A former President of the Permian Basin Board of REALTORS® and a current Director for the Midland Hispanic Chamber of Commerce , Carol is a proven leader dedicated to community growth and ethical business practices. Fluent in English and Spanish, she holds prestigious TRPM and TRLS designations, ensuring her clients, from first-time buyers to seasoned investors—receive expert guidance backed by integrity. Whether navigating a complex transaction or managing a rental portfolio, Carol remains a trusted advisor committed to long-term client success. After moving to San Antonio, where he lived for 25 years, Manny honed his expertise across corporate enterprise, real estate, property management, and marketing. ​ Throughout his career, Manny has remained deeply committed to community impact, collaborating with nonprofit organizations across the state of Texas to drive strategic fundraising initiatives and foster sustainable growth.

An accomplished visual storyteller, he is also an award-winning photographer and videographer whose work has been featured in premier global publications, including Rolling Stone and Billboard magazine.
